title.en: Hide From The Hulk Beginner Guide

description.en: Follow the lobby, role selection, round objective and first escape route with reviewed gameplay screens.

intro.en: Follow the lobby, role selection, round objective and first escape route with reviewed gameplay screens.

body.en: During intermission, check AFK and your selected role. Once the round starts, read the objective, locate your ability bar and choose an exit before engaging.

paragraphs.en: The lobby footage shows an intermission timer and left-side Heroes, Spectate, Store, Cosmetics and AFK controls. Finish menu choices while the timer is visible; close the panel so the next round’s action bar is readable.
The creator announcement says AFK players are excluded from role selection and rounds. Three minutes without input also turns AFK on automatically. If you keep missing selection, check AFK first.

title.en: 2. Read the role and round HUD

paragraphs.en: The top HUD identifies remaining players, a timer and the opposing boss health bar. SURVIVE appears in hero footage, FIND THEM in Hulk footage, and TAKE HIM DOWN in the Ultron encounter. Follow the instruction shown for your round.
Keep two checks separate: your own health and the boss bar. Seeing a full boss bar does not tell you your character is safe. Look at your character panel and the immediate route before attacking.

title.en: 3. Make one attack and preserve an exit

paragraphs.en: In the rooftop footage, doorways connect the outside fighting area with interior corridors and stairs. Before attacking, choose which door or open lane you will use if the boss approaches.

For a first attempt, learn one available action, use it when the boss is occupied, then reposition. This is a conservative learning plan. It makes no promise that a wall, roof or doorway is a permanent safe spot.
The creator’s Doctor Strange announcement says heroes take turns and the player who has waited longest is selected first. An equipped hero and an immediate hero turn are different states.
If a hero is equipped but you have not been selected, remain active, check AFK and read the next round’s selection. Repeated purchases are unnecessary for diagnosing a queue or AFK issue.

title.en: Hide From The Hulk Controls: PC, Mobile & Controller

description.en: Read the actual Captain America, Hulk and Iron Man action bars and understand role-specific inputs.

intro.en: Read the actual Captain America, Hulk and Iron Man action bars and understand role-specific inputs.

body.en: Use your active role’s displayed prompts. Keyboard actions differ between Hulk and heroes, and mobile uses an on-screen ability cluster.

title.en: PC inputs visible in the reviewed build

paragraphs.en: The Captain America recording displays Click for Strike, R for Throw, F for Ride, right-click hold for Block, Q for Shield Charge and X for Slide. Read the equipped action and cooldown before repeating an input.
These bindings were visible in October 20 footage. They should be checked against the current HUD after an update, especially if you use remapped controls.

rows.en: Click Strike; R Throw; F Ride; right-click hold Block; Q Shield Charge; X Slide
Click Smash; Space Leap; Ctrl Run; Q Clap; F Sniff
Click Bolts; right-click Force Field; R Veil; F Vortex; Q Boundary; X Slide; stay still Vanish

title.en: Mobile: use the named action buttons

paragraphs.en: The mobile Captain America screen shows separate Strike, Block, Throw, Ride, Charge, Slide and Shift Lock controls. The movement stick sits on the left and actions on the right. A number inside a button indicates a displayed cooldown state.
Learn one action while keeping the camera and movement usable. If the action has a cooldown number, stop repeatedly tapping and move to a safer route while checking the meter.
The Black Panther controller demonstration displays R2 for Claws and Kicks, X for Spear, circle for Rend and L2 held for Block. Treat these as labels from that role’s recorded controller setup.

The official announcement adds Controller Shift Lock and Auto Run settings, plus a mobile layout rearrangement. Check the current Settings menu for those controls; a full Xbox mapping for every role has not been verified.

title.en: When a correctly pressed input cannot act

paragraphs.en: Iron Man’s mobile screen can show FLIGHT COOLDOWN and THRUSTERS COOLING while the Fly button counts down. That visible state explains why another tap may not start flight.
Check the action’s own meter and wait for the ready state before committing to a route that depends on it. Keep an ordinary doorway or lane available if flight is unavailable.

title.en: Hide From The Hulk Heroes: Ability Reference

description.en: Compare visible Captain America, Iron Man, Human Torch, Sue Storm and Black Panther actions before choosing a role.

intro.en: Compare visible Captain America, Iron Man, Human Torch, Sue Storm and Black Panther actions before choosing a role.

body.en: Pick the action pattern you want to learn, then check its live offer and selection state. A character’s recorded ability list does not establish a permanent tier ranking.

title.en: Compare what each demonstrated kit asks you to manage

paragraphs.en: Captain America has shield and block actions; Iron Man has flight and beam resources. Human Torch uses fire and heat management. Sue Storm has field and concealment states, while Black Panther combines close attacks with a spear.
Use the table to choose a learning goal. Current purchase prices, complete damage numbers and a current Winter Soldier kit are not verified, so this reference avoids a numerical tier list.

title.en: Human Torch: read heat before extending a fight

paragraphs.en: The October 27 hero panel describes fireballs, a flamethrower, fire walls, overheating and Supernova. The same recording shows the character flying above the rooftop.

Before extending an attack, watch the current heat and readiness indicators. Plan a landing route while the ability is still available. The dated hero panel shows 300 health; that figure is a historical screen value, not a claim about every current server.

title.en: Sue Storm: distinguish hidden and seen states

paragraphs.en: In the reviewed Titan footage, Sue Storm becomes translucent while stationary. A later screen explicitly reads INVISIBLE BOUNDARY - YOUR TEAM IS HIDDEN and also displays a separate seen/vanishing state.
Read those status messages before assuming concealment is active. Concealment does not demonstrate invulnerability. Maintain a route around the nearby structures if the boss closes the distance.

title.en: Black Panther: avoid treating a close-range kit as constant safety

paragraphs.en: The controller showcase visibly includes Claws and Kicks, Spear, Rend and Block, with separate meter or cooldown indicators. A close encounter shows Hulk immediately in front of the character.
Practise one approach, an available attack and a retreat before chaining the full kit. No measured damage comparison or guaranteed block protection is established by the reviewed frames.

title.en: Equipped, owned and selected are separate checks

paragraphs.en: The hero panel distinguishes OWNED and EQUIPPED. The official announcement separately describes a rotation for hero turns. First equip the intended owned hero, close the panel and check the next round’s actual role.

For any paid offer, read the current Roblox confirmation and exact item name. This page does not carry over another creator’s price table or assume an older recording’s ownership applies to your account.

title.en: How to Play Hulk in Hide From The Hulk

description.en: Use the visible Hulk action bar, scent information, movement and round objective to plan a chase.

intro.en: Use the visible Hulk action bar, scent information, movement and round objective to plan a chase.

body.en: Read FIND THEM, locate the remaining-player count and use the Hulk-specific action bar. Do not copy a hero’s attack bindings into a Hulk round.

paragraphs.en: The October 20 PC recording shows Smash on Click, Leap on Space, Run on Ctrl, Clap on Q and Sniff on F. It also shows an Anger bar and an ability meter.

Start with ordinary movement and one ability. Check each cooldown before trying a chain. A number on Clap or Sniff means the interface is displaying a timed state, so plan another action instead of assuming it can fire again immediately.

title.en: Use scent information as a clue to the route

paragraphs.en: The reviewed Hulk screens show directional markers and scent-related information around the environment. Survivor footage can display THE HULK HAS YOUR SCENT. These states show that simply leaving the immediate camera view does not prove a player is undetectable.
Use visible clues to choose a direction, then inspect connecting rooms, roof structures and stairs. The reviewed material does not establish a current exact sniff radius or duration.

title.en: Check vertical routes before spending mobility

paragraphs.en: The footage shows Hulk in both the rooftop area and an interior stairwell. Movement between those spaces changes sightlines and the angle to the target.
Before spending Leap or Run, identify the landing or doorway you are aiming for. If the target leaves your view, turn the camera and reacquire a route before using another movement action.

description.en: Understand soldier participation, shared portals and the officially announced way to interrupt an execution.

intro.en: Understand soldier participation, shared portals and the officially announced way to interrupt an execution.

body.en: Read the soldier HUD for the current weapon, maintain an exit and coordinate rescues. The official announcement says an ultimate hit during an execution cancels it.

paragraphs.en: The October 21 soldier recording shows an Assault Rifle with Click Fire, right-click Aim and R Reload prompts. A stance indicator and movement prompts are displayed separately. Check your current HUD before applying recorded keys.

The visible ammunition display separates a magazine count from reserve ammunition. Recheck both before pushing through a doorway. A full current gun inventory, damage table and reward formula remain unverified.

title.en: Interrupt an execution with the announced condition

paragraphs.en: The creator’s announcement states that hitting Hulk with an ultimate during an execution cancels the execution and saves the teammate. The condition is a hit during that event.

Call out the execution, check that your ultimate is available and seek a clear opportunity to connect. This rule does not establish that every ordinary hit works, or that spending an ultimate after the execution ends will reverse it.

title.en: A shared portal can also admit the boss

paragraphs.en: The Doctor Strange announcement explicitly allows soldiers, heroes, NPCs and Hulk to use Strange’s portals. Tell teammates where both ends lead before treating a portal as a regrouping route.

Check the destination and move away from the exit after crossing. Since Hulk can follow, a portal exit needs another escape direction. A complete portal placement shortcut and current duration have not been verified from the reviewed footage.

The October 19 Doctor Strange controller footage labels X as Portal, with orange then blue placement, and shows a Sling Ring meter plus a Place Orange or Move Orange state. Set the intended entrance and destination according to the current role prompts, then recheck both ends. This is a recorded controller example; it does not establish a keyboard shortcut or exact current portal duration.

title.en: Keep team calls short and actionable

paragraphs.en: Use calls that identify a place or event: an execution, a doorway, a ready ultimate or a portal destination. After crossing a doorway or portal, turn the camera to check whether the boss has followed.
Spacing and route suggestions here are editorial tactics. They do not imply a hidden aggro formula, revive mechanic or reward multiplier.

title.en: Hide From The Hulk Maps and Escape Routes

description.en: Read rooftop lanes, indoor stairwells and Titan cover with real gameplay frames.

intro.en: Read rooftop lanes, indoor stairwells and Titan cover with real gameplay frames.

body.en: Treat each position as a temporary route decision. Keep a second exit available, and recheck the boss after moving between indoor and outdoor spaces.

title.en: Rooftop: recognise lanes and roof structures

paragraphs.en: The reviewed rooftop has open lanes, small roof structures, doorways, ladders and a marked helipad. These are visual landmarks for planning a route. A roof object alone does not demonstrate a safe hiding spot.
Before using a flight or leap action, look for the next doorway and the open space behind it. If the boss reaches your lane, rotate toward the alternative route you already identified.

title.en: Interiors: doors and stairs are commitment points

paragraphs.en: The Captain America footage shows an E OPEN prompt at a corridor door. Hulk footage shows a stairwell with a landing and limited visibility around corners.
Check whether the door is open and where the stairs emerge before committing to that route. Pause an attack if your next movement would leave you trapped against a closed door or corner.

title.en: Titan: use the actual terrain and HUD

paragraphs.en: The official Doctor Strange announcement names Titan as a new map. The October 27 Sue Storm sequence shows orange rocky terrain, curved structures, a tall ladder and hexagonal cover.

Use the structure locations to describe a regrouping point, then keep sight of the approach around it. The screenshot supports terrain recognition and a concealment example; it does not prove a permanent boss-proof hiding location.

title.en: When your escape tool is unavailable

paragraphs.en: Flight cooldowns, expended movement and a portal followed by the boss can all leave you needing an ordinary route. Check the current readiness state before stepping into a position that depends on one escape ability.
If the planned action is unavailable, use the nearest observed lane or doorway and turn the camera to track the approach. The specific route depends on the current map state and destruction.

title.en: Hide From The Hulk Cosmetics and Cash

description.en: Read the Cosmetics roll panel, distinguish historical roll costs from current offers and avoid unverified cash claims.

intro.en: Read the Cosmetics roll panel, distinguish historical roll costs from current offers and avoid unverified cash claims.

body.en: Open Cosmetics and read the current pool, odds and price before rolling. The reviewed panel shows hero skins and a currency balance; exact cash earning formulas were not verified.

title.en: What the reviewed Cosmetics panel actually shows

paragraphs.en: The October 23 recording shows a Cosmetics panel with Roll, Heroes and Inventory tabs. The hero-skin panel lists 24 skins in that player’s pool, a single roll priced at 500 and Roll x10 priced at 4,500.

These are historical values for that visible account and recording. Read your current screen before spending. Pool size may depend on the heroes available to the account; the panel itself says the pool is from your heroes.

title.en: Keep the shown odds tied to their panel

paragraphs.en: The same panel displays Rare 65.8%, Epic 25.3% and Legendary 8.9%, with Common and Mythic shown as dashes. It also shows Epic+ and Legendary+ pity counters.

A dash does not justify inventing a drop rate. The visible counters do not establish how every rarity resets or how later updates change the pool. Check the current rules and counters before planning rolls around a guaranteed result.

title.en: Use the visible mission panel as your starting point

paragraphs.en: The October 19 lobby recording shows completed missions for taking out 4 players as Hulk, playing 2 rounds and winning 2 rounds. Their displayed rewards are +650, +150 and +550 respectively, alongside a mission refresh countdown.

For your account, open the current mission list, choose a stated objective and check its completion state after the round. These dated entries establish an actual reward-related interface. They do not establish a fixed current rotation, a repeatable hourly income or an automatic payout formula for every match.

title.en: What remains unknown about earning cash

paragraphs.en: A currency balance and roll prices are visible in the footage. A verified match-by-match earning table, reward multiplier and fastest repeatable farming route were not established.

Read the current end-of-round result and compare its displayed reward with the objective completed. Until that evidence is available, avoid treating survival duration, damage or kills as a confirmed payout formula.

description.en: Separate the current Winter Soldier title from the written Doctor Strange announcement and dated player footage.

intro.en: Separate the current Winter Soldier title from the written Doctor Strange announcement and dated player footage.

body.en: The live title was [WINTER SOLDIER] on October 30. Read the separate official announcement for confirmed portal, AFK, hero-turn and execution changes.

paragraphs.en: Roblox’s game API and the official game page both read [WINTER SOLDIER] Hide From The Hulk on October 30, 2026. This verifies the update label attached to the exact experience. A full Winter Soldier kit and patch log remain unverified.

The October 27 recording visibly includes Human Torch and Sue Storm. Its presenter describes a Fantastic 4 update. Those observations have their own date and should not be relabeled as the current Winter Soldier change list.

The community announcement adds Doctor Strange, Titan, shared portals, AFK, Auto Run, Assault Mode, Controller Shift Lock and a mobile layout rearrangement. It also describes hero turns and the ultimate-hit execution rescue condition.

It states that three minutes without input automatically enables AFK, and AFK players are never selected or put into rounds. The captured announcement supplies a relative age; an exact absolute release date was not independently recovered.

title.en: An Ultron encounter was visible in October 23 footage

paragraphs.en: The reviewed player sequence shows an ULTRON boss bar and TAKE HIM DOWN objective. This confirms a visible encounter in that recording.
A boss appearance does not establish its current selection odds, schedule or full move list. Read the objective at the start of the actual round, then adjust your plan to the current HUD.

Third-party pages conflict: some advertise code strings and generic redemption instructions, while others report none confirmed. No official confirmation or readable redemption result resolved the conflict, so those strings are excluded.

title.en: Where a future redemption guide would start

paragraphs.en: Use the official game and creator community for a code announcement. If the live game adds a code menu, first confirm the exact label and then record the entered code, response and reward.

A button location has not been verified for the current build. This page therefore gives no invented Twitter icon, gift button or Settings path. A real interface and result are needed before publishing those steps.

title.en: Use the documented systems while waiting for code evidence

paragraphs.en: The Cosmetics panel is visible in reviewed footage and has its own guide. The hero and round guides cover systems supported by official text or readable screens.
If a future code fails, record its exact response and version context. Without that response, expiry, a spelling error and an unmet requirement remain separate possibilities.
